draftPullRequest.title: Add isolated measurement provenance helper contracts
draftPullRequest.body:
Add a bounded helper for recording installed WebKit candidate files and prepared measurement context, with eight focused source controls. The helper has no production caller in this change.

This isolates source qualification from the held measurement integration. Existing trace declarations, shared tooling, native workflows and the overhead acceptance repair remain unchanged. The ninth caller-placement control remains with that later integration. Installed candidate identities are explicitly not loaded-library attestation, and this does not establish a timer bound or a 5% overhead pass.

Static parsing, formatting and linting passed in RAM. The eight functional controls are unexecuted and must pass on the exact hosted candidate before acceptance.
